LinkedIn carousel

Fixed term ending soon? A five-slide adviser carousel.

Unofficial sample1/5Slide 1 of 5

Fixed term ending soon? Three things to write down before you talk to your adviser.

Before you ask "fix or float?", ask this first. When does your current fixed term end?

It is the date that sets everything else: how long you have to look at options, and whether there is a break cost to think about. Three things worth writing down this week: your fixed term end date, the rate you pay now, and what your repayments would look like if the rate changed.

General information only, not personal advice. Every household is different.

The honest part

My strongest skills, my proudest piece, and what did not go well.

Strongest skills

Writing and email first.

  1. Writing and emailI write the copy, build it in Moosend, test it and run it. 31 sent, 20.5% opened.
  2. Social contentFacebook and Instagram, planned, written and published: 400 posts a month at New Image.
  3. Canva and videoCanva, CapCut and Microsoft apps. Short animated video, article and podcast images, YouTube assets.
Proudest piece

The email pipeline.

I write the brief, build the email, check it against the brand rules, get approval, then go to Moosend. Each draft waits for approval before it goes out, and each email is checked before it reaches Moosend.

One template and one set of wording per language, so nothing is rebuilt by hand.

Email newsletters

Every newsletter waits for approval before it goes out.

A brief becomes an email, is checked against the brand rules, and goes out only once someone approves it. I built 38 and 31 went out.

Overview

One newsletter

A brief becomes an email and is checked before it goes out. Tap a step to see it.

  1. Write the brief Each email newsletter starts as one brief and one set of content.
  2. Build the email The email is built from one template with one text file per language: English, Chinese and Bahasa Malaysia.
  3. Brand check The draft is checked against the brand rules before it is uploaded to Moosend.
  4. Approval Every draft waits for approval before it goes out.

Overview

Four steps

Posts are built from a list and sent to a review page. Tap a step to see what happens there.

  1. The program builds posts A program builds posts, carousels and reels from a list of the posts to make, so I do not build each by hand.
  2. The team checks them The team checks each post on phone or desktop and leaves notes.
  3. Notes go back together The notes come back together, and the posts are fixed.
  4. Approved posts Approved posts are ready to publish.

The check in the plan
How I work

Plan, make, publish, measure.

How I would work with your advisers: four steps, repeated each month.

  1. Plan

    One topic a month, taken from the questions clients ask the adviser, with the compliance line fixed first.

  2. Make

    Copy first. Email in Moosend, slides in Canva, short video in CapCut. Placeholders for every rate.

  3. Publish

    The adviser signs it off, then it goes out. Nothing goes out unchecked.

  4. Measure

    Opens and booked calls, looked at each month. Opens alone are not enquiries.
